Commentary.Commentary: A good score posted by Australia on a surface which seemed a little slow but they surely would have been eyeing at least 15 more when they won the toss and elected to bat. The problem for them was, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. The openers got them off to a sedate start but just as they got going, Alyssa Healy fell. Ashleigh Gardner then took the attack to the bowlers but just as the game was running away, she fell. Beth Mooney though was brilliant, she batted throughout and is the main reason for her side getting to above 150.
Just the single from the last ball! Shorter and outside off, Tahlia McGrath chops it towards point for one. A lovely comeback from Shabnim Ismail after going for 10 off the first two balls.

OUT! TIMBER! Two in two for Shabnim Ismail! Not sure if sending Georgia Wareham above Tahlia McGrath was the right move! On off, Georgia Wareham swings across the line but misses and the off stump is uprooted. Shabnim Ismail is on a hat-trick.
OUT! Nicely taken! A slower one, outside off. Ellyse Perry is early in the stroke as she looks to drag it over long on. It goes high up in the air and Tazmin Brits takes it at mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! That is a top effort though! Shorter and outside off, Mooney cuts, it goes towards point. Laura Wolvaardt dives to her right but can't hang on. A single taken.
FOUR! Up and over! This is fuller and on middle, Beth Mooney makes room and then lofts it over mid off for another boundary. 10 from the first two balls.
SIX! That is some hit, that is a serious shot! What a start to the last over! Fuller and on middle, this is lofted down the ground and over the long on fence.
South Africa are only allowed three outside the ring in the last over as they have exceeded the time of bowling the 20 overs. Shabnim Ismail to bowl the last over.
A single as this is jammed out through covers.
Two! Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for two.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Just the one! Follows Mooney who works it through square leg for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
A single as this is worked down to long on. Good from Khaka, follows Perry there.
Squeezed through! Fuller and outside off, Beth moves away and guides it past point for three more.

That is outstanding fielding! A full toss on off, this is driven through covers. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, dives and keeps it down to three. Despite the wicket, that is a good over for the Aussies.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to square leg but a dot.
FOUR! Up and over! Beth Mooney makes room, she lofts it over covers and it races away to the fence. Fifty for Mooney. Important knock and she needs to help her side end well.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Shorter and outside off, Ellyse Perry moves away and cuts it over point for another boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! That is some catch, South Africa have been brilliant in the field! This is a really good passage of play for the hosts! On the pads, this is flicked towards deep square leg. Chloe Tryon at deep square leg, runs to her left, slides and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end! That is a top over from Ayabonga Khaka! Outside off, a slower one. Beth Mooney looks to play the reverse paddle scoop but misses.
Just the one again! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Dots are gold right now! Fuller and outside off, this is hit but to covers.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked towards deep square leg for one.
Fuller and on the pads, Lanning swings but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the off side for one. Leg bye.
This lands just short! Beth Mooney walks across, this is full and on the pads, it is worked uppishly towards deep square leg. The fielder does well in the end to stop it.
Shorter and outside off, Lanning cuts but to point.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down towards long on for two.
A single now as this is worked through square leg.
FOUR! Up and over! This is fuller and outside off, Mooney lifts it over cover and it goes to the fence.
That just goes past the off pole! Beth Mooney walks across and looks to play the paddle scoop but misses, it goes just past the off pole.
A full toss on the pads, this is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Another run as this is played through mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Mooney works it through square leg for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Flatter and on off, defended.
FOUR! Meg Lanning is underway! Shorter and outside off, this is cut past point for another boundary.

OUT! TIMBER! Grace Harris departs now. Just as the runs are starting to flow, South Africa strike! This is slower, the length is dragged back. Harris steps out and looks to pull but misses and this one hits the leg pole.
Angled into the pads, Harris works it through square leg for one.
FOUR! That is timed really well! Grace Harris enjoyed that! She skips down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Finds the gap! Out comes the reverse sweep, it is not timed that well but gets it past point. Three taken.
This lands safe! On middle, Harris looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge but lands wide o the cover fielder. One taken.
Two! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
Angled into the pads, Harris works it to square leg.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided to point.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Beth Mooney steps out, she gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Tries for the innovation and it comes off. Walks right across and scoops this delivery around off over short fine leg and into the fence.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
On off, defended.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a brilliant catch and the dangerous Ashleigh Gardner walks back! This is tossed up on off, Ashleigh Gardner does not get to the pitch of it and lofts it down towards long off. It is taken by Sune Luus there. Can South Africa now pull things back?
Commentary.Howout: c Sune Luus b Chloe Tryon

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fuller and outside off, Mooney lofts it over cover for two.
On off, Mooney pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, slower, Ashleigh Gardner swings but misses.
Beth Mooney moves right acorss, this is bowled down the leg side. Wided. A run taken too as the keeper does not collect it cleanly.
A short one and on middle, this is hit through square leg for another one.
Shorter and on middle, Mooney pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
A dot! Looks to be innovative! Brings out the paddle scoop, outside off, misses.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
BEATEN! A slower one outside off, Ashleigh Gardner looks to drive but misses.
A full toss, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
A full one on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Runs flowing now! Excellent placement! Shorter and outside off, Beth Mooney pushes it through covers for a boundary.
Lands short! South Africa would have loved for that to carry! Shorter and on the body, Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull, it goes off the glove but lands short of the keeper.
SIX! Make that two in a row! This is even better! This is full and outside off, Gardner hits it over covers for a biggie.
SIX! BANG! That has gone a long way! Ashleigh Gardner is in full flow now. On middle, fuller, this is lofted down the ground over the long off fence.
On middle, fuller, this is played to mid on.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Mooney looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Hammered! This is fuller and on off, this is smashed through covers, it is to the left of long off for another boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! That is hit really hard! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Risky run but completed! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards deep mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
Tossed up on middle, this is lofted down to long off for one.
Shorter and around middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Another single as Mooney pushes it through covers.
Around off, this is hit to the left of mid off for one more.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Good length and on off, defended.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
A bumper, Mooney lets it go over her. Brilliant from Shabnim Ismail, a maiden in the 6th.
Around off, Mooney guides it to point.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Three dots in a row! Around off, Mooney plays it to covers.
On middle, this is guided to point again.
On off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a soft dismissal and Marizanne Kapp gets the big wicket of Alyssa Healy! That is a nothing shot in the end, it is short and outside off, a slower one. Alyssa Healy looks to cut it over cover, looks to pull out in the end but too late, in the end, lobs an easy catch to Nadine de Klerk at cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Nadine de Klerk b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, Alyssa Healy looks to cut but misses.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Takes full toll of the Free Hit! Beth Mooney walks across, this is full and around off, she drags it over mid on for a boundary.
NO BALL! Kapp oversteps! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Up and over! This is a slower one and Alyssa Healy picks it, it is lofted over the mid on fielder and it races away.
FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! On the pads, Mooney plays it past the square leg fielder and this one races away to the fence.
Another run as this is pulled through mid-wicket.
Tip and run again! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Close! Beth Mooney steps out, the length is shortened. Mooney looks to flick but misses.
Angled into the pads, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Around off, on a good length, this is guided to point.
A dot to end! On off, this is driven but to cover.
FOUR! Wonderfully timed! This is fuller and a little wider outside off. Mooney opens the face of the bat, gets it past point and this one races away to the fence.
Yet again, bowling to her field, fuller and outside off, not as full as the last two but still fuller. Mooney looks to drive but is beaten.
Fuller and on off, this is driven but straight to the cover fielder. It is a packed off side field.
Just short! Fuller and outside off, Mooney drives uppishly but it lands just short of the fielder at point.
Fuller and on the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided.

NOT OUT! That is a poor review. It is slipping down leg. South Africa lose a review. On the pads, full, Alyssa Healy looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side. A run taken. Leg bye signaled. Reviewed but in vain.
A loud shout but turned down. South Africa Women review but it seems to be slipping down leg.
Tip and run! On off, this is played with soft hands towards cover for one.
A good short one but Alyssa Healy has no problem in pulling it towards fine leg for one.
Solid! Length and on off, Alyssa Healy defends.
FOUR! Slammed away! Shorter and outside off, Alyssa Healy stands tall and slaps it over cover for a boundary.
That is a good start! A yorker on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Shabnim Ismail to bowl from the other end.
Angled into the pads, this is worked wide of long on for one. That is a good first over for the Aussies.
On the stumps, blocked.
Floats it up on off, Alyssa Healy defends.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
FOUR! Off the mark in a boundary. a strong sweep shot. On the pads, the sweep is nailed, it is hit through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, this one skids on, it is pushed back to the bowler.

Time for the action to begin. The South African players make their way out to the middle and they are followed by the Aussie openers, Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney. It is spin to begin with as Nonkululeko Mlaba has the new ball in hand. Here we go...

South Africa Women (PLAYING XI) - Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Nadine de Klerk, Sune Luus (C), Anneke Bosch, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Nonkululeko Mlaba.

Australia Women (PLAYING XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Georgia Wareham, Jess Jonassen, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

Sune Luus says they wanted to bat first too but she does not feel the surface will change a lot and they will now need to bowl well. Informs they are going in with the same team. Ends by saying they need to stay calm and give their best.

Meg Lanning says they are going in with the same team and they have all bases covered. States it is super exciting to lead this team into another finals and they are excited for this game. Adds South Africa is a great team and they will come hard at them and they are ready for it.
TOSS - Australia Women WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT!

The Aussies are hands down, the best side going around, they are unbeaten so far in the tournament and they have also beaten South Africa earlier in the tournament. Without a doubt they head into this fixture as big time favourites but the hosts will be having a lot of support, they head into this game after a moral boosting win. This is their first ever World Cup final. Can they upset the odds? They will have to play out of their skin if they are to do so. Stay tuned for the toss.
DRUMROLLS! It is time for the finals! All to play for, winner takes it all, it is Australia, the defending champions against South Africa. This promises to be a cracker. Who will come out on top?
... MATCH DAY ...
